reasoning_steps: Identify the areas of the semicircles and the full circle.
Calculate the area of the shaded region by subtracting the area of the smaller semicircle from the area of the larger semicircle.
Note that the area of the shaded region is the difference between the area of the larger semicircle and the area of the smaller semicircle.
Express the ratio of the shaded area to the unshaded area in terms of the diameters a and b.
Conclude that the ratio of the shaded area to the unshaded area is the square root of the ratio of the diameters.
